panel.title: Speed vs. print quality
panel.hook: Why a fast printer is not always the better buy for figurines.
body: Printers advertise top speeds, but fine detail comes from slow outer walls, cooling and a stiff frame. A CoreXY printer keeps quality at higher speeds because its print head is light.
For your use, small figurines, quality matters more than raw speed: most of the print time goes into thin layers and supports, not into fast infill.

opinion.text: Owners report quieter prints with the enclosure closed.
